problem.stem:
A sealed container contains a gaseous sample at 300.0 K 

consisting of either pure ethane (C2H6), pure neon (Ne), 
or a mixture of the two.  The pressure inside the container 
at this temperature is 1.00 atm.  When the container is 
cooled to 150.0 K, the pressure is 0.37 atm.  What is the 
composition of the sample?  (The vapor pressure of C2H6 
at 150 K is 0.10 atm; the critical temperature of Ne is    
44 K.) 

CO(g) + 1/2 O2(g) → 
CO2(g) 

∆H°rxn = –283.0 kJ mol-1 

Fe2O3(s) + 3 CO(g) →  
2 Fe(s) + 3 CO2(g) 

∆H°rxn = ???
choices: (C) A mixture of ethane and neon.
(D) It cannot be determined from the information given. Page 4 Property of ACS USNCO – Not for use as USNCO Local Section Exam after March 31, 2022

givens: P1 ≠ P2, implies mixture or pure gas

steps.text: Use ideal gas law to compare states
Consider pure C2H6 and Ne separately
Compare with vapor pressure of C2H6 at T2
Check if P1 > vap P(C2H6) + P(Ne)
Ensure mixture or pure gas fits pressure change

skeleton.final_form: If P1 > 0.37 atm, then mixture; else pure C2H6
quick_checks: Ne critical temp < T2, pure Ne unlikely
